<style>
/* Global Container */
.minimal-dynamic-grid {
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: row !important;
    flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
    gap: 60px !important;
    align-items: flex-start !important;
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .minimal-dynamic-grid {
        flex-direction: column !important;
        gap: 40px !important;
    }
    .minimal-dynamic-gallery, .minimal-dynamic-details {
        width: 100% !important;
    }
}

/* ----- GALLERY SKINNING ----- */
.minimal-dynamic-gallery {
    position: sticky;
    top: 120px;
    flex: 0 0 55% !important;
    max-width: 55% !important;
}

.minimal-dynamic-gallery .woocommerce-product-gallery {
    opacity: 1 !important;
    width: 100% !important;
}

.minimal-dynamic-gallery .woocommerce-product-gallery__wrapper {
    border-radius: 20px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #F8F5F2;
    width: 100% !important;
}

.minimal-dynamic-gallery img {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: auto !important;
    object-fit: cover;
}

.minimal-dynamic-gallery .flex-control-thumbs {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    margin: 20px 0 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
}

.minimal-dynamic-gallery .flex-control-thumbs li {
    width: 100px !important;
    float: none !important;
    flex: 0 0 100px;
}

.minimal-dynamic-gallery .flex-control-thumbs img {
    border-radius: 8px;
    opacity: 0.6;
    transition: 0.3s;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
}

.minimal-dynamic-gallery .flex-control-thumbs img.flex-active, 
.minimal-dynamic-gallery .flex-control-thumbs img:hover {
    opacity: 1;
    border-color: #688F9D;
}

/* ----- DETAILS SKINNING ----- */
.minimal-dynamic-details {
    flex: 0 0 40% !important;
    max-width: 40% !important;
}

.minimal-dynamic-details .product_title {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif !important;
    font-size: 56px !important;
    color: #0E1B30 !important;
    margin: 0 0 16px !important;
    line-height: 1.1 !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
}

.minimal-dynamic-details .price {
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif !important;
    font-size: 24px !important;
    color: #1A1A1A !important;
    margin-bottom: 24px !important;
    display: block !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
}

.minimal-dynamic-details .woocommerce-product-details__short-description {
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif !important;
    font-size: 16px !important;
    line-height: 1.8 !important;
    color: rgba(14,27,48,0.7) !important;
    margin-bottom: 40px !important;
    font-weight: 300 !important;
}

/* ----- CART BUTTON SKINNING ----- */
.minimal-dynamic-details form.cart {
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: column !important;
    gap: 20px !important;
}

.minimal-dynamic-details form.cart .quantity {
    border: 1px solid rgba(14,27,48,0.1) !important;
    border-radius: 100px !important;
    padding: 0 20px !important;
    height: 60px !important;
    display: inline-flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
}

.minimal-dynamic-details form.cart .quantity input.qty {
    border: none !important;
    background: none !important;
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif !important;
    font-size: 16px !important;
    color: #0E1B30 !important;
    width: 50px !important;
    text-align: center !important;
}

.minimal-dynamic-details button.single_add_to_cart_button {
    height: 60px !important;
    background: #688F9D !important;
    color: #FFFFFF !important;
    border-radius: 100px !important;
    padding: 0 48px !important;
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif !important;
    font-size: 13px !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    text-transform: uppercase !important;
    letter-spacing: 2px !important;
    border: none !important;
    transition: all 0.4s ease !important;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(104, 143, 157, 0.2) !important;
}

.minimal-dynamic-details button.single_add_to_cart_button:hover {
    background: #0E1B30 !important;
    transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
}
</style>
